page.intro: One colour list for leather, textile and thread, with each colour's Pantone or RAL reference and what uses it; and each private-label customer's logos, label artwork, packaging rules and brand colours.

tile.unusedHint: No colourway, material colour or branding set uses them
tile.setsHint: Sets in use: their brands' labels and tech packs read them

notice.label: Notices

ignored.title: This filter could not be applied: {value}
ignored.body: The list shows every colour without it. The address may be old, or no colour has that value.

brands.title_one: {count} private-label brand makes styles without a branding set
brands.title_other: {count} private-label brands make styles without a branding set

noHex.body: Their chip is striped wherever it is shown. Add the hex in the list or in Edit colour.

notice.setRestored: Branding set {code} is in use again.

use.notInRole: Not in your role: material colours need the materials right

held.noColours: Keeping the colour library needs the product.colours.manage right (the production manager has it).
held.noBranding: Keeping branding sets needs the product.branding.manage right (sales and the production manager have it).
held.noUpload: Sending a file needs the files.upload right.
held.noneActive: None of the selected colours is in use.
held.noneArchived: None of the selected colours is archived.
held.noneActiveSets: None of the selected sets is in use.
held.archived: Archived: restore it to change it.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to colours
forbidden.body: Colours & artwork needs the product.styles.view right: every role that works with styles has it (production manager, sales, quality, planner).

empty.title: No colours yet
empty.body: Add the first colour: its code, name, Pantone or RAL reference and hex.
empty.bodyView: The production manager adds colours to the library.

archive.reach: No new colourway, material colour or branding set can pick an archived colour.
archive.inUse_one: {count} of them is in use: what names it keeps it.
archive.inUse_other: {count} of them are in use: what names them keeps them.
archive.back: Restore brings a colour back at any time.

restore.reach: A restored colour can be picked again by colourways, material colours and branding sets.

form.companyHint: Only this company's styles and materials can pick it.
form.everyCompanyHint: One library colour for every company.
form.codeHint: Our reference, unique: capital letters and digits, with . _ - / inside (NX-BLK).
form.name: Name
form.systemHint: The colour card the reference comes from.
form.referenceNeeded: Needed, in the system's form (for example {example}).
form.referenceOwn: Optional, our own swatch's reference (for example {example}).
form.familyHint: For the filters: black, blue, red…
form.photoHint: A JPEG, PNG or WebP of the real swatch; the newest photo is the colour's.

problem.code: 1 to 40 capital letters or digits, with . _ - / inside.
problem.name: Name the colour: 1 to 120 characters on one line.
problem.reference: Pantone, RAL and NCS colours need their reference; a reference needs its system; 1 to 40 characters.
problem.setName: Name the set: 1 to 200 characters on one line.
problem.ruleKey: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes (hang-tag), each key once.
problem.ruleText: Say the rule in 1 to 500 characters on one line.
problem.ruleItem: Pick a material of the set's company, or none for a rule in words.
problem.ruleQuantity: A quantity above 0, at most 4 decimals.

sets.title: Branding sets
sets.intro: Per private-label customer: logos, label artwork, packaging rules and brand colours. One set in use per brand and company.
sets.label: Branding sets
sets.archivedRow: An archived set: open it to restore it.

archive.reach: Its brand's labels, label lines and tech packs no longer read it; nothing printed changes.
archive.back: Restore brings a set back while its brand has no other set in use.

empty.title: No branding sets
empty.body: Start a set for a private-label customer: its logos, label artwork, packaging rules and brand colours.
empty.bodyView: Sales and the production manager keep the brands' sets.

set.readOnly: You can read this set; keeping it needs the product.branding.manage right.
set.restoreHeld: {code} is in use for this brand: archive it first.
set.archiveBody: Its brand's labels, label lines and tech packs no longer read it. Nothing printed changes; restore brings it back.
set.restoreBody: It becomes the brand's set in use in this company: labels, label lines and tech packs read it again.
set.archivedBody: Nothing reads it. Restore it to change it.
set.archivedOther: Its brand uses {code} now. Archive that one before restoring this.
set.noteHint: For the office: what the brand sends and when.
set.filesHint: A logo is a picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP); label artwork a picture or a PDF. The first logo is the set's picture.
set.rulesHint: How the brand's garments are packed and tagged. A rule with a material adds that line to a draft BOM (label lines).
set.noMaterialsRight: Picking a material needs the product.materials.view right.
set.rulesFull: A set holds at most 50 rules.
set.pickColour: Pick a colour of the library…
set.noMoreColours: Every active colour is in the set
set.noStyles: No style of this brand in this company.
set.moreStyles: And more: the first 50 by code.
set.stylesHint: The brand's styles of this company (and those of every company): their labels and tech packs read this set.
set.stylesArchivedHint: The brand's styles: they would read this set again once restored.

newSet.title: New branding set
newSet.intro: A set belongs to one customer or brand, in this company. Its logos, artwork, rules and colours are added once it is started.
newSet.name: Name
newSet.hasActive: This brand uses {code} ({name}) in this company
newSet.replaceTick: Archive {code} and use the new set instead
newSet.after: Next: add the logos, label artwork, packaging rules and brand colours in the set.

held.brand: Pick the customer or brand first.
held.company: Open a company first: a set belongs to one company.
held.fields: A code of 1 to 60 characters without spaces and a name.
held.replace: Tick the box to archive the brand's set in use, or pick another brand.
